smell_validity.evidence: Eleven modules each replace one shared acquisition block with their own divergent marker machinery; pickle, copy, name-validation and description policies already disagree, so one responsibility plainly demands coordinated changes. The removed uniform import and surviving public owner make the healthy-design boundary unmistakable, and the drift already visible among policies shows the practical cost.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Marker provisioning now carries eleven local policies that must be kept in agreement by hand; any cross-cutting repr, pickling or copying decision requires editing and retesting every copy, and missing one silently yields inconsistent library behavior. Consolidation restores a single long-term ownership boundary for a package-wide concern.

development_plausibility.evidence: Fragments read as organic self-containment drift matching visible repo habits (queueutils BList fallback, existing try/except blocks) and real module roles: OMD copying, pickled trace results, BarrelList slots, IndexedSet tombstones. Each carries a locally reasonable rationale; no paste regularity or task-shaped scaffolding is visible.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pinpoints divergent local marker machinery, sets the finished state (one shared source, dead code removed) and explicit preservation: identity, falsiness, printed names in docstring examples and trace output, pickle and copy survival, full suite. It preempts incomplete audits, left-behind cruft and cosmetic-only regressions while leaving placement open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Fragments embody different purposes: cacheutils memoization plus pickle resolution, dictutils identity-preserving copy, queueutils import-time name validation, urlutils description metadata, iterutils repr format, setutils dynamic type assembly. Each demands a different code-supported decision about what the shared implementation must support, keep or drop.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the affected areas, and every fragment self-describes marker machinery, so several searches find the scope even though names vary (a sentinel search misses _NoDefaultType, _UnsetType, _MissingCellType). Bare object bindings and unrelated import fallbacks must be excluded; classification stays within single modules without cross-component combination.

repair_coordination.evidence: Rules interact: moving creation to one shared implementation simultaneously changes where pickle names resolve (fragments reduce through their own module globals) and how copy identity is preserved, coupling reuse, serialization and naming. Rewiring one module while leaving another keeps policies split and violates the stated single-source outcome.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: A reconnect-to-shared-helper rule covers most sites since binding names and identity-check consumers are untouched; but dictutils copy preservation, cacheutils memo and pickle resolution, iterutils repr format and unused urlutils descriptions each need a separate decision, leaving about seven of eleven within the 60 to 80 percent band.

behavioral_risk.evidence: A repair dropping dictutils __deepcopy__ passes ordinary lookups but silently breaks identity checks once a caller deep-copies a structure holding a marker, returning it as a real value. Faulty pickle resolution similarly fails only when trace data or cache keys are shipped. Ordinary failures like missing names or repr changes hit doctests and the suite.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
